Class OllamaProcess

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ollama.OllamaProcess
public final class OllamaProcess extends Object
The OllamaProcess type runs the ollama command with a fixed argument list. The command is started directly, not through a shell. Standard output and standard error are combined into one captured string. The capture stops at 65536 bytes. The type has no instances.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public static String run(String[] args, long timeoutMs) throws Exception
      The run method starts ollama and returns the combined output. The args array holds the tokens that follow the program name, such as stop or list. validate(String[]) rejects a missing list, an empty token, .., and the characters ;, |, &, <, >, newline, and carriage return. The process redirects standard error into standard output. The method reads that stream until the process exits or timeoutMs milliseconds have passed. Captured text stops growing at 65536 bytes. The method sleeps 50 milliseconds between reads while the process is still alive. If the process is still alive at the deadline, the method destroys it and throws Exception with the message ollama timed out after plus the timeout plus ms. If the process exits with a code other than zero and the captured text is blank, the method throws Exception with the message ollama exited plus that code. If the process exits with a code other than zero and the captured text is not blank, the method returns that text, a newline, and (exit plus the code plus ). If the process exits with code zero, the method returns the captured text alone.
      Parameters:
      args - The tokens that follow the ollama program name.
      timeoutMs - The number of milliseconds to wait before the process is destroyed.
      Returns:
      The combined output, with an exit suffix when the process exits non-zero and still printed text.
      Throws:
      Exception - The arguments were rejected, the wait timed out, the process failed with no text, or reading the process failed.

    • drainRemaining

      private static void drainRemaining(InputStream in, ByteArrayOutputStream captured)
      The drainRemaining method copies bytes that are already waiting on the process stream. Copying stops when the capture reaches 65536 bytes or when no more bytes are waiting. Any exception from the stream is ignored.
      Parameters:
      in - The combined output stream of the process.
      captured - The buffer that already holds earlier output.

    • validate

      public static void validate(String[] args) throws Exception
      The validate method rejects arguments that could change the command or walk a path. If args is null, the method throws Exception with the message No ollama arguments. If a token is null or empty, the method throws Exception with the message Empty ollama argument. If a token contains .., the method throws Exception with the message Illegal ollama argument. If a token contains ;, |, &, <, >, a newline, or a carriage return, the method throws Exception with the message Illegal ollama argument.
      Parameters:
      args - The tokens that would follow the ollama program name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The list was missing, a token was empty, or a token contained a rejected sequence.
